title.narrative: Study B2B platform Circular Agriculture for small and medium scale farmers in Colombia

description.narrative: In line with the Dutch vision of circular agriculture and with the efforts of the Colombian government to introduce circularity in the country, the LAN Agricultural Department of the Netherlands embassy in Colombia has developed its own Circular Agriculture strategy, where Colombia and the Netherlands meet. This strategy supports the ambition of the Dutch government to cooperate with other countries in circularity in the most relevant sectors of the economy, in particular in which the Netherlands is dependent for its imports. The project creates a Dutch–Colombian B2B platform on circular agriculture and living lab for best practices, which targets local Colombian small and middle-scale farmers to operationalize this strategy and sets the basis for cooperation in the field of Circular Agriculture between the Netherlands and Colombia. Among the most relevant problems faced by these farmers in Colombia are low productivity rates, use of high amounts of pesticides and water use per square meter of crop production, dependency on animal feed imports from abroad, and most of all, the lack of indicators to measure and benchmark their performance against other producers. Many Dutch companies have limited awareness of the needs of Colombian farmers concerning more sustainable agriculture and the possibilities the Colombian market has. The Dutch private sector offers a variety of solutions to circular agriculture that could benefit Colombian farmers. For example, alternatives for pesticide use such as biological control, water-saving techniques, soil improvement, know-how to locally rear insects as protein sources for animal feed and digital solutions for farmers that optimize inputs and productivity. The gap between demand in Colombia and supply in the Netherlands appears to be one of the main reasons for limited business and access to the Dutch market of Colombian agricultural producers.The B2B platform aims to provide Colombian small and middle-income farmers with access to Dutch expertise, technology, innovative solutions for circular production, and improved market opportunities in key agro-subsectors. This platform serves as a space to meet the needs of these farmers and improve their agricultural practices.The project provides insights about the needs, viability, feasibility, structure and content of such a platform and living lab, which will be used by the LAN Agricultural Department of the Netherlands embassy in Colombia to decide on the future implementation of the platform to support small and medium scale farmers. Besides, the project provides insights into how the existing Dutch circular agriculture platform (Platform Kringlooplandbouw) managed by the Dutch Ministry of LNV can eventually be linked with the future Colombian B2B platform.
